resources.string: Places and stay sync

Optional and separate from audio sync. Uploads stay times, representative coordinates, accuracy and named places to Supabase. No movement trail or audio is included, and nothing is sent to Gemini. Stays expire after 7 days; saved places remain until deleted. Tracking still requires an explicit start.

First enable imports saved watch places. While enabled, manage places and the shared stay threshold in the web portal. Later enables apply cloud settings, replacing local place settings. Changes apply between tracking sessions. Turning off stops future uploads; existing cloud data must be deleted separately in the portal. Privacy: haptilog.keepory.app/privacy.html
